title: THE GOD WHO WILL NOT BE IGNORED

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text:
"'If you remain hostile toward me and refuse to listen to me, I will
multiply your afflictions seven times over, as your sins deserve. I will
send wild animals against you, and they will rob you of your children,
destroy your cattle and make you so few in number that your roads will be
deserted'" - Lev 26:21-22 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The warnings grow heavier, and the key phrase is "if you remain hostile
toward me." The issue is a settled, ongoing hostility — a heart that keeps
refusing to listen even after repeated appeals.

These are severe covenant consequences spoken to national Israel, and we
must not casually transfer them onto individual believers today or read
every tragedy as divine punishment. But we should hear the underlying
truth: God will not be endlessly ignored without consequence. He is too
real, too holy, and too committed to His people to simply let rebellion
run on forever.

Dear reader, there is actually mercy hidden even here. A God who did
nothing while His people destroyed themselves would not be loving. The
escalation shows a God who keeps pursuing, keeps calling, keeps refusing
to give up on a wandering people.

Think of how the New Testament describes God's patience. He is patient,
not wanting anyone to perish, but everyone to come to repentance (2 Pet
3:9). Yet that same patience has a purpose — to lead us to repentance
(Rom 2:4), not to leave us comfortable in rebellion.

The tragedy in this passage is not that God responds. It is that His
people kept refusing to listen. Every affliction was, in a sense, a
knock on a door that stayed shut.

Do not be a person God has to keep knocking for. When you hear His voice,
soften your heart today (Heb 3:15).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Is there any settled hostility or resistance to God in me?
2. Have I been ignoring something God keeps bringing to my attention?
3. What would it mean to soften my heart and listen today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Father, thank You that You refuse to give up on Your people. Soften any
hardness in me, and give me ears that listen the first time You speak.
Amen.
